protectionLead.message: Page checks run in this browser. PhishGuard downloads shared threat data and may request a site icon for brand comparison; uploads require a separate reporting opt-in.

protectionOnHint.message: Review pages as they load. Turning this off pauses all PhishGuard page checks.

grpScamsHint.message: Compare addresses with known threats and look for suspicious structure or brand imitation.

grpPopupsHint.message: Watch for fake support warnings, command-paste tricks, and unexpected clipboard changes.

grpShoppingHint.message: Look for storefront risk signals and mismatches between ad labels and destinations.

grpCryptoHint.message: Inspect selected wallet requests for unusually broad or dangerous permissions.

grpPrivacyHint.message: Watch for form data sent to unrelated sites and common browser-fingerprinting techniques.

optBlockKnownHint.message: Stop destinations included in the browser’s local threat rules before the page opens.

optPageAnalysisHint.message: Combine page wording, form structure, address signals, and available brand clues to find risks not yet listed.

optClickfixHint.message: Flag human-verification pages that instruct visitors to open a system command box and paste a command.

optFakeupdateHint.message: Identify web pages that present a download as a required browser or system update.

optHideHint.message: Visually mark selected prize and giveaway blocks when their wording matches known scam patterns.

optQrScanHint.message: Check eligible images for QR codes and analyze decoded HTTP(S) destinations. Cross-origin images may be unreadable to the browser.

optTechscamHint.message: Flag pages using alarm language, forced fullscreen, dialog floods, or phone-number demands to pressure visitors.

optClipboardHint.message: Warn when a page changes the clipboard to a command or cryptocurrency address without a clear user action.

optShopHint.message: Combine signals such as resettable countdowns, artificial scarcity, missing contact details, and high-risk payment requests.

optSerpHint.message: On supported search pages, compare an ad’s displayed destination with its actual link and mark suspicious mismatches.

optWalletHint.message: Inspect supported transaction requests for blind signing, token approvals, NFT-wide permissions, and account delegation.

optLeakyFormHint.message: Look for values typed into email or phone fields being sent to an unrelated origin before a form is submitted.

optFingerprintHint.message: Watch for repeated use of canvas, WebGL, audio, and font-measurement APIs that can help identify a browser.

optNotifyHint.message: Flag pages that pair a fake continuation step with a request to allow browser notifications.

optStrictHint.message: Use a stricter response: pages rated suspicious receive a full-screen warning instead of the usual lighter notice.

optReportingHint.message: Optionally sends a site hostname and compact risk signals to a relay you configure. Disabled by default; review the report fields below.

trustedLead.message: Exceptions and timed pauses are listed here. Remove an entry to restore normal checks for that domain.

optTenantApexBadge.message: This exception affects the entire shared host $APEX$. Remove it and add a narrower domain exception instead.

historyLead.message: This log stays in browser storage and keeps hostnames rather than complete page addresses.

feedLead.message: قائمة محدَّثة باستمرار لمواقع الاحتيال المعروفة، مبنية من قوائم عامة للتصيّد والبرمجيات الخبيثة ذات تراخيص موثَّقة. لا يفعل PhishGuard سوى تنزيلها.

backupHint.message: Download a JSON backup of preferences and site exceptions, then import that file into another browser profile when needed.

syncHint.message: حافظ على تطابق إعداداتك والمواقع الموقوفة مؤقتًا في كل متصفّح تسجّل الدخول إليه. تستخدم مزامنة متصفّحك نفسه — ولا يزال PhishGuard بلا حساب أو خادم. مُعطّلة افتراضيًا.

optWhatSentBody.message: When reporting is enabled, a report may include the hostname, verdict, reason codes, compact numeric risk signals, bounded hashed page-feature buckets and page-structure counts, matched brand/icon signals, extension version, and an hour-bucketed timestamp. It excludes the full URL path and query, raw page text, typed content, and cookies. The reporting server can still receive ordinary connection metadata. Retention is controlled by the relay operator.

hotListSub.message: A second list focuses on threats reported during the previous 48 hours and refreshes hourly.

optFeedUrlHint.message: Only use a compatible feed URL that you control or trust. A failed override can interrupt updates; reset restores the configured default.

optLangHint.message: Changes the language used for PhishGuard alerts and controls. The selection can follow your browser setting or be chosen directly.

supportFreeOnDevice.message: PhishGuard مجاني ويعمل بالكامل على جهازك.

netNoTelemetry.message: Most analysis stays in this browser. Network activity is limited to threat-feed requests, selected site-icon requests, and reports only when you configure and enable a relay.

receiptFeedDetail.message: PhishGuard requests shared threat-list files. These requests do not include the page you are viewing, but the feed host can receive normal connection metadata such as your IP address.

receiptReportDetail.message: فقط عند تفعيل الإبلاغ وإعداد نقطة نهاية، تُرسل النطاق والحكم ورموز الأسباب ومؤشرات الخطر الموجزة. لا تُرسل مسارات URL الكاملة أو نص الصفحة أو المحتوى المكتوب.

receiptIconDetail.message: May request the page’s favicon for local brand comparison. The request can reveal your IP address to the icon host; no full page content is sent by this check.

optExportSyncHint.message: Backups can be moved manually. Browser sync is optional and uses the browser account’s sync service.

reason_ipHost.message: The destination uses a numeric IP address rather than a conventional domain name.

reason_atSymbol.message: An at-sign in the address can make the visible text differ from the actual destination host.

reason_urlUserInfo.message: The address contains login information before the @ sign, which can disguise the actual destination host.

reason_executableScheme.message: This link uses an executable or active-content URL scheme rather than an ordinary web address.

reason_punycodeHost.message: The domain is encoded with punycode, which can appear in look-alike domain attacks.

reason_idnHomograph.message: Some characters in this domain visually resemble the real $BRAND$ name.

reason_brandLookalike.message: The domain has features commonly seen in attempts to imitate a familiar brand.

reason_suspiciousTld.message: This top-level domain has a higher-than-usual presence in scam reports.

reason_noHttps.message: This address does not use HTTPS, so network traffic may be readable or modifiable in transit.

reason_manySubdomains.message: عدد غير معتاد من النطاقات الفرعية.

reason_urgencyKeywords.message: The address combines several urgency or account-security terms.

reason_randomHost.message: The host label has a high-entropy pattern often seen in disposable campaign domains.

reason_brandFuzzyMatch.message: The hostname resembles $BRAND$’s known domain. Inspect the exact spelling before signing in.

reason_deepSubdomainChain.message: Several nested subdomains make the site owner harder to recognize at a glance.

reason_longHostLabel.message: An unusually long hostname label may be hiding brand-like words or misleading structure.

reason_shortenerHost.message: This link uses the shortener $HOST$, so the final site cannot be judged from this address alone.

reason_riskAbusedTld.message: امتداد النطاق العلوي لهذا الموقع ($TLD$) له معدّل مرتفع من إساءة الاستخدام في الاحتيال ضمن جداول مخاطر خِلاصة تهديدات PhishGuard.

reason_riskDynamicHost.message: This domain uses dynamic DNS or a free-hosting service that appears frequently in abuse reports.

reason_brandForeignSuffix.message: The address uses $BRAND$’s name with an unfamiliar .$SUFFIX$ ending.

reason_gatewayRedirect.message: A redirect through $HOST$ led to a different destination, which can conceal the final site.

reason_feedBlock.message: يطابق هذا النطاق خِلاصة تهديدات PhishGuard، مؤكَّد من قِبل $COUNT$ مصدر (مصادر) مستقل(ة).

reason_feedWarn.message: يطابق هذا النطاق إدخالًا أقل ثقة في خِلاصة تهديدات PhishGuard ($COUNT$ مصدر (مصادر)) — تابع بحذر.

reason_remoteDestinationConfirmedMalicio.message: An independent remote check confirmed malicious behavior at this link destination.

reason_linkedDestinationFeedBlock.message: A linked destination matches PhishGuard's exact-confirmed high-confidence blocklist.

detail.example: The page contains a credential form posting to an unrelated domain.

reason_newDomain.message: The domain appears in a newly registered domain list; very new sites have little reputation history.

reason_credentialFormForeignDomain.message: A password form sends credentials to a different domain from the page showing it.

reason_crossOriginCredPost.message: The form sends password or card-like data to $HOST$, which differs from the current site.

reason_hiddenIframes.message: The page contains hidden frames that could load content or collect input out of view.

reason_scamPhrase.message: The page contains giveaway or reward language associated with common scam patterns: “$PHRASE$”.

reason_seedPhraseAsk.message: The page asks for a wallet recovery phrase. Anyone who obtains it can take control of the wallet.

reason_brandImpersonationContent.message: The page imitates the appearance or wording of $BRAND$ without using its verified domain.

reason_deliveryFeeScam.message: The page imitates $BRAND$ and requests card details for a package fee. Confirm delivery notices through the carrier’s official site.

reason_brandIconMismatch.message: The page displays an icon associated with $BRAND$ while using a different website address.

reason_credentialFormOnTenantHost.message: A password form appears on shared hosting ($HOST$), where unrelated users can publish their own pages.

reason_brandInTenantHost.message: $BRAND$ appears in a shared-hosting address that requests a password.

reason_contentPhishingPattern.message: The combination of wording and page layout resembles previously observed phishing pages.

reason_techScamScareText.message: The page uses threatening technical-support language: “$PHRASE$”.

reason_techScamPhoneAsk.message: The page pressures visitors to call a support number, a frequent pattern in impersonation scams.

reason_techScamFakeAlert.message: This appears to be a web-based system alert demanding attention. Verify alerts through the operating system, not the page.

reason_techScamFullscreen.message: The page requested fullscreen, which can be used to make scam warnings harder to dismiss.

reason_techScamAlarmAudio.message: The page played alarm-like audio that can pressure visitors into acting quickly.

reason_techScamDialogFlood.message: The page generated repeated dialogs that can obstruct normal navigation.

reason_walletBlindSign.message: The wallet was asked to sign opaque data whose effects are not obvious from the request.

reason_walletPermitApproval.message: This Permit-style signature can grant later token or NFT transfers without another prompt.

reason_walletDelegation7702.message: This EIP-7702 request delegates account execution to a contract; review the target and its permissions carefully.

reason_walletSetApprovalAll.message: This request can authorize a contract to transfer every NFT in a collection.

reason_walletUnlimitedApprove.message: This approval may let a contract spend an unlimited amount of the selected token.

reason_walletTokenApprove.message: This request grants a contract permission to spend the selected token amount.

reason_clickfixPasteRun.message: The page instructs you to paste and execute a system command. Treat command-paste verification as high risk.

reason_clickfixFakeCaptcha.message: The CAPTCHA-like step asks you to open the Windows Run dialog and execute a command, which real CAPTCHA tests do not require.

reason_clickfixWinR.message: The page directs you to the Windows Run box and asks you to paste text into it.

reason_clickfixCaptchaDisguise.message: The command instructions are presented as a human-verification task.

reason_clipboardCommand.message: A system command was detected on the clipboard. Do not paste it into a terminal or Run dialog unless you independently understand it.

reason_clipboardCryptoAddress.message: A cryptocurrency address appeared on the clipboard. Verify the destination independently before using it.

reason_fakeUpdatePrompt.message: A web page offers a browser or system update download. Updates should be obtained from the browser or operating system’s own updater.

reason_msgOtpAsk.message: The message asks for an OTP, PIN, passcode, or password. Treat requests to share these secrets as high risk.

reason_msgScamWording.message: The message contains wording associated with common scams: “$PHRASE$”.

reason_msgUrgencyDeadline.message: The message uses an artificial deadline or urgent demand to pressure a quick response.

reason_msgDangerousLink.message: A link in the message triggered address-risk checks: $URL$.

reason_qrCodeDestination.message: A QR code resolves to $URL$. Review the destination before opening it on another device.

reason_shop_countdownReset_detail.message: The offer timer appears to reset between visits, weakening the claim that the deal is about to end.

reason_shop_offPlatformPay_detail.message: Checkout asks for a hard-to-reverse method such as a wire, payment app, or crypto transfer.

reason_shop_fakeScarcity_detail.message: The page uses injected scarcity language such as “only a few left” or viewer counters.

reason_shop_badgeHotlink_detail.message: A “secure” or “verified” badge appears to be a linked or embedded image rather than independently verifiable proof.

reason_shop_missingContact_detail.message: The store lacks basic business contact details, making the seller harder to verify.

obLead.message: PhishGuard evaluates page signals in this browser. It also downloads threat lists and may request site icons. Reports are not sent unless you configure and enable a relay.

obPhishingBody.message: Flags forms whose credential destination does not match the site presenting them.

obBrandBody.message: Compares site identity signals—including known brand icons and domain patterns—to look for impersonation.

obPageBody.message: Uses local wording and layout signals to identify suspicious login pages that may not appear on a threat list yet.

obWalletBody.message: Reviews supported wallet requests for dangerous token permissions and recovery-phrase traps.

obClipboardBody.message: Alerts when a page attempts to place a command or cryptocurrency address on the clipboard.

obPopupsBody.message: Identifies pressure tactics such as fake support warnings and repeated dialogs, with options to leave the page.

obPinBody.message: اضغط أيقونة قطعة الأحجية في شريط الأدوات، ثم الدبوس بجوار PhishGuard، لترى حالة كل صفحة بنظرة واحدة.

continuePausesHour.message: يوقف PhishGuard مؤقتًا في هذا الموقع لمدة ساعة.

optHotRejected.message: PhishGuard rejected the latest recent-risk list because its validation failed; the last accepted list remains active.

interstitialFooter.message: فحص PhishGuard هذه الصفحة على جهازك.

reason_newDomainUnvisited.message: This domain appears on a newly registered domains list and has no prior visit history in PhishGuard.

continueOnce.message: ينقلك إلى هذه الصفحة مرة واحدة. يبقى PhishGuard قيد التشغيل.

optReportUrlHint.message: Leave this empty to keep feedback local. If you set a relay, use an HTTPS endpoint you control or trust. Saving a changed address turns reporting off until you opt in again.

reportRelayMissing.message: أدخل عنوان إبلاغ HTTPS في صفحة «حول» قبل تفعيل الإبلاغ.

reason_qrExternalAction.message: The QR payload tries to open an app or use a non-standard website link. Review it before continuing.

reason_qrMalformedDestination.message: The QR code contains a malformed web address, so its destination cannot be reliably checked.

qrValidSafeLabel.message: Valid QR · No strong destination risk found

reason_downloadDisguisedExecutable.message: The shared item uses a document or image-looking filename followed by an executable extension. Do not open it.

reason_downloadExecutableSurface.message: The page exposes an executable or installer download ($FILE$). Verify the publisher and file through an independent security scanner before opening it.

reason_downloadScriptSurface.message: The page exposes a script or command file that can execute actions on the device. Do not run it unless you can verify its origin and contents.

reason_downloadSafetyEvasion.message: The page asks you to weaken or bypass device security before opening a file. This is a strong malware-delivery warning.

reason_downloadDeceptivePrompt.message: The page uses an update or verification story to persuade you to download or run a file. Verify updates through the operating system or application itself.

reason_downloadArchivePressure.message: The shared archive is paired with instructions or pressure that may conceal an executable payload. Do not extract or run unexpected contents.
